scope: Keep the complete five-project, zero-retry, one-worker WP-014 quality verdict unchanged while reducing repeated local browser-test setup cost.
Move reviewed project eligibility ahead of shared combat and Practice navigation so excluded project results remain accounted for without opening pages or sockets.
Write and verify a deterministic production-build proof over declared build inputs and exact client/server outputs, and rebuild automatically whenever that proof is absent or stale.
Let focused, matrix, and performance browser commands reuse only a verified build; retain fresh-build behavior on a cache miss and preserve CI project sharding.
Document a fail-fast local development funnel and guard quality/performance worker settings from accidental parallel overrides.

Limit tracked outputs to README.md, docs/planning/implementation_plan.md, docs/process/development_workflow.md, docs/evidence/wp-014g.json, package.json, scripts/build-proof.js, scripts/build-and-start-test-server.js, scripts/run-playwright.js, tests/browser/support/project-routing.ts, tests/browser/combat.spec.ts, tests/browser/practice.spec.ts, tests/tooling/browser-build-proof.test.js, tests/tooling/browser-build-environment.test.js, and tests/tooling/playwright-quality-policy.test.js.
